description: chat-server (chat.rs:24,144, ban.rs:28, space.rs:24,140, message.rs:24,155, contact.rs:24,279, emoji.rs:24,140, invite.rs:27, presence.rs:29, position.rs:29) and jmap-server (handlers.rs:30,146,153,231,238) all do serde_json::from_value(v.clone()) when args is a borrowed &Value. The clone is unnecessary; serde_json::from_value takes the Value by value, but it could be avoided by cloning at a higher level once (e.g. with args.get(…).and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()))) or, better, by restructuring to consume args (Value::Object destructure). mail-server fixed this in mailbox.rs/submission.rs by doing args.remove(...) which avoids the clone. The chat-server and jmap-server handlers should adopt the same pattern. Gratuitous clone forces an allocation on every request.
title: gratuitous v.clone() in serde_json::from_value calls
